cardArt.title: The Qantas American Express Ultimate Card

product.description: The Qantas American Express Ultimate Card comes with excellent benefits. Receive a Qantas Travel Credit every year, enjoy airport lounge access, complimentary travel insurance and earn Qantas Points with every dollar spent.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Long term visa means 12 months or more and does not include a student visa.
eligibility.additionalValue: You are an Australian citizen or permanent resident or hold a long term visa.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Additional Cards are available for any friend or family member 16 years and over
Applications are assessed based on the information provided and are subject to credit approval.

features.additionalInfo: Add up to 4 Cards at no additional fee.
The Amex App lets you quickly and easily manage your Card Account anytime, anywhere.
Fraud Protection Guarantee, protecting you from unauthorised charges made on your Account.
A flexible way to pay off a selected amount or portion of your Credit Card balance in equal monthly instalments. Subject to fees.
Terms, conditions, cover limits and exclusions apply.
Card Purchase Cover, covering eligible items purchased with your Card

2.25 Qantas Points on eligible Qantas products and services per $1 spent.
1.25 Qantas Points on everyday purchases, except spend at government bodies in Australia where you'll get 0.5 Qantas Points per $1 spent.
After a total of 100,000 Qantas Points is earned in a calendar year, the everyday earn rate will change from 1.25 to 1 Qantas Point per $1 spent.

Whether it's shopping, dining, travel or entertainment, eligible Card Members can access Amex Offers providing statement credits or bonus points. Amex Offers must be saved to the Card and used for qualifying spend, subject to offer-specific criteria, to receive a benefit.
Get pre-sale tickets and access to some of your favourite events, and enjoy the Amex Entertainment Lounge before the show at select venues. With Amex, you can dive into unforgettable experiences.
Enjoy two American Express Lounge passes per year at Sydney and Melbourne airports.

Your Qantas American Express Ultimate Card gives you two complimentary single entry invitations to the Qantas Club Lounge at selected domestic and international airports, each membership year after your first spend on selected Qantas products and services.

Earn 3 points per dollar spent on all Qantas Wine purchases
Complimentary Qantas Wine delivery within Australia (exclusions apply)

Enjoy a $450 Qantas Travel Credit each Membership year to use on eligible domestic and international Qantas flights. Use your annual Qantas Travel Credit to book online with American Express Travel Online.

Dreaming of your next adventure? Turn dreaming into doing by redeeming your Qantas Points for a Classic Flight Reward with Qantas and their participating partner airlines. Your points can be used for a one way, return or multi-destination Classic Flight Reward on over 50 partner airlines and affiliates and over 1,300 destinations worldwide.
